snippet.title: CARDINAL CROSS Chapter 1 - The Scavenger
snippet.description:
I finally got the time to play at least the first chapter through. I got to know main character Lana and her new companion at the beginning of their journey in the galaxy. What is all about this artifact that Lana is going to sell?

Thanks to the awesome creator Impqueen aka Rinmaru, who also made Ascension visual novel. If you haven't see those, go see!
